authorization.text: 按照这个顺序继续实现吧，关闭js的帧问题后，要把Windows的dll精简包和同版本预览方案做的彻底一些
authorization.scope: JS frame closure, complete Windows consumer DLL and matching preview delivery

required_changes: Reproduce and close pending-frame/new-input handoff with real WebGL completion and exact existing Runtime work identity
Reuse one RuntimeComposition, Facade, Scene, Text and History per SDK instance
Deliver Windows axiom.dll with memory-safe versioned handle/buffer boundary and a C++ consumer facade, complete supported control/input/document/resource surface and Windows adapter
Provide a working external Windows application without Semantic/Skia/component library dependencies
Provide DLL/import-stub/public-header/assets/licenses consumer package; internal static components remain build inputs only
Produce JS and Windows consumer SDK/demo artifacts from one exact revision with manifests, hashes, external-consumer verification and prerelease CI
forbidden_changes: new canonical model, History or generic transaction owner
required_proof: RED then GREEN real-browser delayed-fence/input regression, superseded work, resize/loss/recovery, no repeated completion or endless idle loop
Existing JS core/browser/example and npm pack/offline install/TypeScript consumers
Strict Windows DLL build with published locked dependencies and external caller using only consumer package
DLL capability/command parity, allocation ownership, stale/foreign/wrong-thread/lifecycle rejection, real native input/IME bridge and shutdown
Existing affected Windows Runtime/History/Text/Image/Connector/Section/selection regressions; preserve separately documented baseline failures
Fresh consumer ZIP verification and same-revision/version/hash checks before GitHub prerelease publication
terminal_success: Required implementation and automated proof complete, exact matching preview artifacts independently consumable and published; physical-only items explicitly pending, no stable/Gate/PHYS claim
terminal_blockers: unresolvable exact input or authority conflict
new high-impact failure requiring an owning semantic decision
physical_validation: User observation remains separate; synthetic/native automated input is not PHYS acceptance
